svg.text: TAKE-HOME JOB AID 02: THE 11-STOP WORK ORDER LIFECYCLE
Eleven stops. One rule: Pass it clean, or stop it honestly.
Every stop has an intake requirement, an active judgment, and a strict rejection route when evidence fails.

g.text: • Tag line items B / D / A
Missing/Deficient QC Evidence (Stop 07) → Dispatches return trip to Field (Stop 05) | Uncertain Occupancy (Stop 03) → HALTS all dispatch until servicer verifies.
